title: Many Cultures in One City
text:
Our city has people from many countries. Some families cook food from their home countries, and their neighbours can taste new dishes. Children learn many languages at school. Many people say this makes the community richer.

Cultural diversity also means different holidays. In autumn, some people celebrate a festival with lights, and others have a special dinner in winter. When we learn about these traditions, we understand each other better. A classroom with students from different countries is a good example of this.

questions.text: What do some families do, according to the first paragraph?
options: Cook food from their home countries

questions.text: When do some people celebrate a festival with lights?
Why do children in the city learn many languages?
options: Because many people in the city come from different countries
Because the schools have no teachers
Because languages are only used on holidays
Because they all want to become doctors

questions.text: What does the writer probably think about cultural diversity?
options: It helps people understand each other
It creates problems for every city
It is not important for students
It is only good for restaurants

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who live in the same area or share something
a special event, often with music, food, or celebrations
customs or ways of doing things that people keep over time
to know what someone means or why they do something

paragraph_translations: Nasze miasto ma mieszkańców z wielu krajów. Niektóre rodziny gotują potrawy ze swoich rodzinnych krajów, a sąsiedzi mogą spróbować nowych dań. Dzieci w szkole uczą się wielu języków. Wielu ludzi mówi, że dzięki temu społeczność jest bogatsza.

Różnorodność kulturowa oznacza też różne święta. Jesienią niektórzy ludzie świętują festiwal z lampionami, a inni zimą jedzą specjalną kolację. Kiedy poznajemy te tradycje, lepiej się rozumiemy. Klasa z uczniami z różnych krajów jest dobrym przykładem tego.
